title: Cortex as a bounded context layer, not a general memory dump
summary: Fixture for a public ABVX work/publication item about Cortex boundaries and usefulness.

payload.excerpt: Fixture for a bounded public ABVX publication about Cortex as a reusable context layer.
body_lines: Cortex is useful when it stays bounded: explicit sources, explicit privacy, explicit retrieval budgets.
That is the difference between a reusable context layer and a vague personal-memory promise.
ABVX uses Cortex as a donor-backed capability only where the retrieval contract is concrete and fail-closed.
